criteria.criterion: Apple used 100 percent recycled cobalt in all Apple-designed batteries by its 2025 goal
required_elements: the cobalt was used in all Apple-designed batteries
criteria.promise_scope: Apple promised that by its 2025 goals it would use 100 percent recycled cobalt in all Apple-designed batteries; beneficiaries are unspecified product users/stakeholders, and location is unspecified.
criteria.observed_scope: “Apple now uses 100 percent recycled cobalt in all the batteries it designs and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets.” “Today, all batteries designed by Apple are made with 100 percent recycled cobalt, and all magnets are made with 100 percent recycled rare earth elements.”
criteria.explanation: The cited sources document the terms of the undertaking.
criteria.gap: The excerpts do not tie an observed occurrence to the promised scope.

occurrence_witness.action_quote: Apple now uses 100 percent recycled cobalt in all the batteries it designs

entailment_check.incomplete_delivery_alternative: The cited evidence shows the pledged cobalt content is now in all batteries Apple designs, but c3/c4 do not state that this was achieved by the 2025 goal deadline; it could have been completed sometime after 2025 and still make all quoted statements true.
entailment_check.observed_fact: In Apple's 2026 newsroom report, Apple says it now uses 100 percent recycled cobalt in all the batteries it designs, and says all batteries designed by Apple are made with 100 percent recycled cobalt.

trace.label: UNVERIFIED
trace.verdict: The available evidence does not establish delivery of the requested obligation.

Promised scope: Apple promised that by its 2025 goals it would use 100 percent recycled cobalt in all Apple-designed batteries; beneficiaries are unspecified product users/stakeholders, and location is unspecified.
Observed scope: “Apple now uses 100 percent recycled cobalt in all the batteries it designs and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets.” “Today, all batteries designed by Apple are made with 100 percent recycled cobalt, and all magnets are made with 100 percent recycled rare earth elements.”

Cited source excerpts (promise, delivery, or context as assessed above):
c1: “Earlier this year, Apple surpassed 99 percent on the way toward its 2025 goals to use 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets and 100 percent recycled cobalt in all Apple-designed batteries.”
https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/04/apple-surpasses-60-percent-reduction-in-global-greenhouse-gas-emissions/

c2: “On top of hitting 30 percent recycled content across all of its products shipped in 2025, Apple also reached several targets for recycled content in select components last year.”
https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/04/apple-accelerates-progress-with-highest-ever-recycled-material-in-its-products/

c3: “As part of this work, Apple now uses 100 percent recycled cobalt in all the batteries it designs and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets.”
https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/04/apple-accelerates-progress-with-highest-ever-recycled-material-in-its-products/

c4: “Today, all batteries designed by Apple are made with 100 percent recycled cobalt, and all magnets are made with 100 percent recycled rare earth elements.”
https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/04/apple-accelerates-progress-with-highest-ever-recycled-material-in-its-products/

c5: “recycled cobalt used in all Apple-designed batteries”
https://www.apple.com/supply-chain/
